notes.title: Update v0.06: 8 New Languages! (+ Minor Fixes)
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thanks to the translators from EastAsiaSoft, RunBean Galactic is now available in 8 more languages: French, German, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean!

In addition, the game received a small balance change: upon breaking a wall or running into a "reverse direction" signpost, the astronauts will now stay slowed down for a bit longer. Also, I fixed the artifacts in the game's sound effects that used to appear when the music was muted.

I hope you'll enjoy this update!

Yours Forever,
Ivan (Khud0)

notes.title: Updates v0.04 and v0.05 (Bug Fixes & New In-Game Objects)
notes.content:
• Update v0.04 (September 13th, 2022): Fixed two rare, but very important and game-breaking bugs, found by [url=https://twitter.com/SpectrumTinted]RoseTintedSpectrum[/url].
• Update v0.05 (September 26th, 2022): Replaced the "Shield & Wall" combo with "Key & Lock" and "Bomb & Wall" combos to address the game design issues, described in [url=https://youtu.be/bdeoqnOQYCg]this video[/url] by Defunct Games.
